title: Life Manager: Local Open Source or Cloud Hosted? One Core, Two Ways to Run It
markdown:
# Life Manager: Local Open Source or Cloud Hosted? One Core, Two Ways to Run It

Life Manager is one proactive manager for work, money, everyday responsibilities, body, and mind. The product page states the choice plainly: run the same open-source core locally, or use Life Manager Cloud from your phone on a dedicated Maritime VM. This article compares only what the product page actually says.

## The local way: run it on your own computer

Read the source, connect your tools, and define what to delegate. Run Life Manager in your own environment. The local route is open source, and the README and code are public on GitHub. Some capabilities require setup or are still being developed, and the product page says so.

Choose local if you want to read the source first, run the manager in your own environment, and handle setup yourself.

## The cloud way: Life Manager Cloud on Maritime

Life Manager Cloud is the hosted mode of the same manager, designed to run continuously on a dedicated Maritime VM and report verified progress to your sign-in email. Every user gets a dedicated agent of their own, and that agent works on its own computer on Maritime. Start with Google identity only; Calendar or Gmail inbox access, a task prompt, goals, budget, or payout details are not required at signup.

Life Manager Cloud is $29/month after a 7-day free trial. Price on the site: 29 USD.

Choose cloud if you want the manager running continuously without running it on your own computer, and you want to start from your phone with Google identity only.

## What is the same in both

One manager for your whole life. It chooses useful priorities, carries work forward, and verifies outcomes, including income-generating work, without a daily prompt. Calendar travel-time planning is one workflow, not the product. No daily instructions or user-defined goals and budgets are required by the product design.

## What cloud adds, stated honestly

Its first earning workflow uses Capafy. Publisher Certification and publisher confirmation of selected Skills and configuration are required before each Agent version can go live. Life Manager reports listings and earnings only after Capafy confirms them. The complete Cloud-to-Capafy path is still being verified, and earnings are not guaranteed.

## A simple decision

If reading the source and running your own environment matters most, start local. If continuous running on a dedicated Maritime VM matters most, start cloud with the 7-day free trial, then $29/month. Either way, start from the product page, where the price, the trial, and the sign-up requirements are stated plainly:

- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm
- Life Manager Cloud, hosted on Maritime: https://aniccaai.com/maritime

One manager for your whole life.
